name: vehicle-traffic-routing-visual
description: Visual check: multiple vehicles on shared navmesh cause congestion with waiting state and traffic jam alert. Confirmed via direct engine trace (Finding #22) that the traffic_jam event genuinely fires at tick 25 once the tick budget was corrected — see the tick 26 step for detail.

steps.description: Bumped cash from the 50k default to 150k -- same reasoning as vehicle-traffic: all 4 debris_haulers need to exist for the routing test.

campaign start replaces the whole GameState including cash, reset to the level's own startingCash -- a `new_game ... cash:N` override does not survive this step (tried, reverted; see vehicle-3d-rendering-visual for the same finding).
Left unmarked: cash is already at or below cost, so the buy button is disabled (Finding #1/#16's class) -- the console command has no funds guard and overdraws anyway.

Split from a single tick 20 into smaller batches so a screenshot lands mid-route, before every vehicle has arrived and gone idle — TRAFFIC_JAM_MIN_TICKS=10 needs at least that many ticks of contention, so the congestion shot is captured around cumulative tick 12, not tick 20+ (#411).

expect.note: all 4 vehicles still converging on (37,33) — real jam confirmed at tick 25, see the tick 26 step below (Finding #22)

steps.description: Finding #22: a direct engine trace (sampling state.events.pendingEvent tick by tick) found the jam actually fires at absolute tick 25, not tick 20 as this step previously assumed — the previous 6+16=22 tick budget was 3 ticks short and left the event unfired every run. Extended to 6+26=32 for real margin past the confirmed tick-25 fire point (verified: all 4 vehicles converge on (37,33), vehicle #1 occupies it, #2/#3/#4 all enter the waiting state simultaneously and cross TRAFFIC_JAM_MIN_TICKS=10 together, satisfying TRAFFIC_JAM_MIN_VEHICLES=3 — unlike vehicle-traffic.json's Finding #21, converging all 4 purchased vehicles rather than 3 is exactly what makes this one work).

expect.note: confirmed via direct engine trace that state.events.pendingEvent is {eventId:'traffic_jam', firedAtTick:25} at this point — no scalar field exists in SerializableGameState to assert that directly, so this anchors on the fleet staying intact at 4 while the jam condition is met
